summary.text: Nathan Small is a Democratic state representative from District 36 who has served in the New Mexico House of Representatives since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the House Appropriations and Finance Committee and previously served on the Las Cruces City Council.

paragraphs.text: Nathan Small earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in English and philosophy from the College of Wooster.
He was a member of the Las Cruces City Council before being elected to the New Mexico House in 2016.
In the 57th Legislature, Wikipedia reports, Small chairs the House Appropriations and Finance Committee and serves on the Energy, Environment and Natural Resources Committee.
His wife, Xochitl Torres Small, represented New Mexico's 2nd Congressional District from 2019 to 2021 and served as U.S. Deputy Secretary of Agriculture from 2023 to 2025.
